description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related Science or Mathematics field, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience; or Master's degree, plus 6 months of relevant experience.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities For This Position

Help make the technologies, products and services that make a difference. That’s the opportunity that’s waiting for you at General Dynamics Mission Systems. We help our nation’s heroes keep our nation safe by creating solutions so advanced, they redefine innovation for the world. It’s an amazing challenge. And it’s waiting for you now.

We apply advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, AR/VR, Cloud Native and Quantum Physics to solve our customers’ missions in cyber, RF, undersea, interstellar space and everything in between.

As a Senior Test Engineer, you’ll participate in the update and execution of test plans, test procedures and possibly test harnesses for systems of systems. You'll be developing and conducting functional, operational, environmental, and/or performance tests on hardware, software and systems.

Utilizing your expert knowledge and understanding of test engineering concepts and principles, the tests you'll define and conduct will ensure proper operation of systems developed in an agile development process.

You'll be expected to:

  • Develop top-notch deliverable test plans and test procedures
  • Conduct iterative, structured integration and testing in a lab environment on a scheduled, regular basis
  • Conduct scenario and performance testing: automate realistic training scenarios, including multiple participants, engagement events, degraded communications, and validation of latency, throughput, and event accuracy
  • Troubleshoot and report defects: Analyze logs, packet captures, timestamps; reproduce failures; and document actionable defects
  • Interact with a wide variety of functional representatives during all phases of development
  • Help troubleshoot and/or gather sufficient data to conduct troubleshooting of issues found
  • Interact with customer representatives on a regular basis prior to and during formal testing events
  • Occasionally travel to customer sites for integration, fielding and acceptance testing of hardware and software systems
  • Document formal test results


What you’ll experience:

  • Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
  • A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
  • Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered


What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, a related specialized area or field (or equivalent experience) plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree
  • Solid knowledge in use and understanding of test engineering concepts, principles, and theories
  • Solid knowledge and experience with object-oriented programming, system processes and scripting languages
  • Automated test execution: Ability to select and configure test suites, manage test data, develop and execute unattended runs, monitor results, and distinguish system defects from test-script or environment failures
  • Openly proposes ideas that enhance productivity and efficiency, solicits input, and optimizes solutions
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Strong technical writing abilities


What sets you apart:

  • Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success, meeting and exceeding personal and team commitments
  • Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle increasing responsibilities with growing complexity
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development
  • Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Role Description:

The Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer in the Real-Time Applications unit is a key contributor responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing cutting-edge solutions using DSP and Microcontroller technologies. This role provides also technical guidance, supporting junior and mid-level engineers, and ensures the system meets performance.

This role is ideal for an experienced senior engineer who is ready to expand into people management, technical leadership, and team coordination, while still maintaining a active hands‑on engineering involvement.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement real-time systems, including DSP algorithms and microcontroller firmware, tailored to project requirements.
  • Ensure software meets strict real-time performance constraints, focusing on latency, throughput, and efficient use of system resources (e.g., memory, processing power).
  • Optimize performance and efficiency of signal processing algorithms and embedded systems.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical guidance, best practices, and support for skill development.
  • Conduct code reviews, design evaluations, and testing to uphold high-quality standards.
  • Investigate, debug and resolve complex technical issues in real-time systems, ensuring reliability and robustness.
  • Propose innovative solutions to technical challenges.
  • Design high quality systems which comply with regulatory standards.
  • Stay updated on advancements in DSP and Microcontroller technologies to introduce innovative approaches to system design.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the optimization of workflows, tools, and methodologies. Contribute to the creation and maintenance of comprehensive technical documentation.
  • Support workload planning, task prioritization, and resource allocation across ongoing and upcoming projects.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performance team culture.
  • Identify skill gaps and training needs; create personalized development plans.

Essential Criteria:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in the design, simulation, implementation, verification and validation of real-time systems on DSPs and Microcontrollers.
  • 5+ years of professional experience i in programming in C++ and C languages.
  • 5+ years of professional experience with Real Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
  • Good knowledge of theory and design of complex digital electronic circuits and digital signal processing algorithms (FFT, digital filters, re-sampling, ecc.).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving attitude.
  • Experience in the use of laboratory equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, signal generators).
  • Experience with peripheral standards and communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, RS485, RS232, RGMII, ecc.).
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python).
  • Proficiency in source code revision control, especially GIT.
  • Good knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Desirable Criteria

  • Good knowledge of SHARC or equivalent DSP architecture.
  • Knowledge of FPGA architecture and design, as well as HDL languages.
  • Good Knowledge of build systems (CMake).
  • Proficiency with gitlab, docker, CI/CD, artifactory.
  • Experience with application layer protocols, such as DNP, 1588, MQTT, and more.
  • Knowledge of electronic components and PCB reworking.
  • Experience with TCL scripting.

title: (Junior) QA Engineer/Software-Tester (m/w/d) – Produktqualität & Testautomatisierung
description:
Über diesen Job

Suchst Du eine Position, in der Du analytisches Denken, technisches Verständnis und Qualitätsbewusstsein mit echter Produktnähe verbinden kannst?

Bei CHECK24 Steuer arbeitest Du an einem mehrfach ausgezeichneten Steuerprodukt mit komplexen Entscheidungslogiken, datengetriebenen Prozessen und KI-gestützten Features. Du sorgst dafür, dass neue und bestehende Features zuverlässig funktionieren, analysierst Fehlerbilder und verbesserst unsere Produktqualität nachhaltig. Dabei setzt Du auf strukturiertes Testing, durchdachte Testkonzepte und gezielte Automatisierung.

Wenn Du Freude daran hast, komplexe Zusammenhänge präzise zu durchdringen und Qualität aktiv mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung als (Junior) QA Engineer/Software-Tester (m/w/d) bei der Verbraucherportal Deutschland GmbH (einer Tochtergesellschaft der CHECK24 Gruppe) in Dortmund.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem technischen, naturwissenschaftlichen, mathematischen, wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen oder vergleichbar analytisch geprägten Bereich mit sehr guten Leistungen – alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Starkes analytisches Denkvermögen und Freude daran, komplexe Regelwerke, Systemzusammenhänge und Entscheidungslogiken strukturiert zu durchdringen
  • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein, Genauigkeit und ein gutes Gespür für Details, Sonderfälle, Grenzfälle und Risiken
  • Erste Kenntnisse in Skripting oder Programmierung und Motivation, Dich in Testautomatisierung, Qualitätssicherung und moderne Testing-Ansätze weiter einzuarbeiten
  • Interesse daran, KI-gestützte Funktionen, LLM-Ergebnisse und automatisierte Entscheidungsprozesse systematisch zu überprüfen und zu verbessern
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit dem Anspruch, Fehler nicht nur zu finden, sondern Ursachen nachhaltig zu verstehen
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) sind erforderlich

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen

  • Qualitätssicherung & exploratives Testing: Du testest unsere Software auf Web-, iOS- und Android-Plattformen und stellst durch strukturierte sowie explorative Tests eine hohe Produktqualität sicher.
  • Analyse & Produktverbesserung: Du arbeitest Dich tief in unsere Steuer-, Produkt- und Entscheidungslogiken ein, analysierst fachliche Anforderungen sowie Bugs im Detail und leitest daraus präzise Testfälle, Prüfszenarien und Verbesserungen für Produkt, Prozesse und Testabdeckung ab.
  • Testkonzeption: Du erstellst, pflegst und erweiterst Testfälle und Testszenarien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement und Softwareentwicklung und denkst dabei gezielt in Sonderfällen, Grenzfällen und möglichen Fehlerszenarien.
  • Testautomatisierung & Tooling: Du entwickelst automatisierte Testverfahren weiter, nutzt geeignete Tools und Technologien und trägst dazu bei, wiederkehrende Prüfungen stabil, reproduzierbar und skalierbar abzusichern.
  • KI-Validierung: Du überprüfst die Qualität unserer KI-gestützten Funktionen, bewertest Ergebnisqualität, identifizierst systematische Fehlerbilder und unterstützt beim Aufbau geeigneter Validierungsansätze.
  • Release- & Prozessqualität: Du begleitest Releases, prüfst neue Features vor Livegang und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Test-, Freigabe- und Qualitätsprozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

title: Manual Software Tester in Healthcare (all genders)
description:
About Us

Our mission at Avelios is to unlock clinical data to power seamless healthcare operations for better patient care. To do so, we have built a modular software platform that digitizes and optimizes workflows in hospitals with cutting-edge technology in a user-friendly way. With our software, we enable hospitals, doctors & nurses to provide their patients with the best possible care.

We are growing fast and want to keep expanding our team and business to fundamentally digitize healthcare for the better. We appreciate different backgrounds and see diversity as one of our strengths.

THE TEAM AND YOUR ROLE

As a Manual Software Tester in Healthcare (all genders), you ensure that our software not only works reliably but also delivers an excellent user experience in the healthcare environment. Whether you bring experience in software testing and quality assurance or a clinical background with a strong interest in technology and software, you contribute your perspective to continuously improving the quality of our platform.

In close collaboration with our Product and Engineering teams, you identify issues early, improve usability, and help ensure the stability and quality of our software, contributing directly to a better digital care experience in hospitals.

YOUR TASKS

  • Test software quality: Manually test our software for functionality, design, usability, and content accuracy based on defined requirements and test plans.
  • Identify and document issues: Detect, reproduce, and precisely document all types of deviations, from spelling mistakes and usability inconsistencies to technical bugs.
  • Manage bug reporting: Create clear and reproducible Jira tickets for identified issues and track their progress through resolution.
  • Maintain test documentation: Develop and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and test reports to ensure consistent and traceable testing.
  • Verify fixes: Conduct regression tests for resolved issues to confirm fixes and ensure that existing functionality remains stable.
  • Contribute your perspective: Apply your QA experience or clinical understanding to identify opportunities to continuously improve the quality and usability of our software.

Your Qualifications

  • Either experience in software testing, test methods, and quality assurance or professional experience in a clinical environment, such as nursing, medicine, or another healthcare profession with a strong interest in software and technology
  • Technical understanding, perseverance, and a strong commitment to quality
  • Highly structured and self-driven working style
  • Strong attention to detail and passion for precise results
  • Solution-oriented mindset and hands-on mentality
  • Experience with Jira is a plus
  • Fluent in German and English

Your Benefits

  • Variety in your tasks and the opportunity to take ownership
  • An international, informal team structure in a motivating start-up atmosphere, allowing you to participate directly in our customer growth story and the overall success of Avelios
  • Ability to gain valuable hands-on experience in a startup backed by leading international VCs
  • Support for your personal development through continuous learning and feedback
  • Set your own rhythm with flexible working hours and trust-based time tracking
  • A virtual stock option package (VSOP) that lets you participate in Avelios’ long-term value creation
  • A monthly meal allowance up to 75 euros, full coverage of the Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club or a subsidized Wellpass membership, a bike leasing program and Corporate Benefits that give you access to discounts from a wide range of providers in various areas
